parameters.name: Account
parameters.description: The username of the account that is used for the AD server.

parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description: The domain on the AD server.

parameters.name: EmailMapping
parameters.description: The field that is used to indicate the email address of a user on the AD server.

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: The condition that is used to filter users.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The bastion host ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.

parameters.name: IsSSL
parameters.description:
Specifies whether SSL is supported. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false**

parameters.name: MobileMapping
parameters.description: The field that is used to indicate the mobile phone number of a user on the AD server.

parameters.name: NameMapping
parameters.description: The field that is used to indicate the name of a user on the AD server.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: The password of the account that is used for the AD server.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The port that is used to access the server.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.

>  For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

parameters.name: Server
parameters.description: The address of the AD server.

parameters.name: StandbyServer
parameters.description: The address of the secondary AD server.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-instance-ad-auth-server --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --server 192.168.XX.XX --standby-server 192.168.XX.XX --port 389 --is-ssl true --base-dn dc=test,dc=com --domain domain --account cn=Manager,dc=test,dc=com --password 000000 --filter objectClass=top --name-mapping nameAttr --email-mapping emailAttr --mobile-mapping mobileAttr --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost ModifyInstanceADAuthServer --region cn-hangzhou --Account 'cn=Manager,dc=test,dc=com' --NameMapping nameAttr --Server '192.168.XX.XX' --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000' --Port 389 --StandbyServer '192.168.XX.XX' --Filter 'objectClass=top' --BaseDN 'dc=test,dc=com' --IsSSL true --EmailMapping emailAttr --MobileMapping mobileAttr --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Domain domain --Password 000000
